title: Robert Saleh: Wan'Dale Robinson being evaluated for concussion after "cheap" hit in Bears joint practice

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh: Wan'Dale Robinson being evaluated for concussion after "cheap" hit in Bears joint practice
sources.description: Titans head coach Robert Saleh gave an update on wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson after Robinson made an early exit from Thursday's joint practice with the Bears.
